transition-model-stages.alt: Graph of the demographic transition model in five stages. The birth rate stays high in stages 1 and 2, falls in stage 3 and is low in stages 4 and 5. The death rate is high in stage 1, falls in stage 2 and stays low, rising a little in stage 5, where it is above the birth rate. A dashed line shows total population rising slowly, then fast, then leveling and falling slightly.
